pages.text:
Bold style. Bold capability.
Get after it with confidence in the 2027 Nissan Kicks.® From the chiseled
grille and sleek LED headlights to the impressive 141-hp engine and available
Intelligent All-Wheel Drive system, Kicks brings an elevated level of style and
capability to your off-the-beaten-path adventures.2 Ramp up the looks even
more with Kicks Rock Creek,® a new addition to the Rock Creek family
lineup, which includes blacked-out badges, gloss-black accents, black
tubular roof rack4 and embroidered leatherette front seats. When the next
adventure calls, Kicks can help you get there.
Nissan Kicks Rock Creek® shown in Canyon Bronze Metallic / Super Black Two-tone.3

pages.text:
All-wheel confidence
Don’t let the forecast spoil the fun. Kicks® offers available
Intelligent All-Wheel Drive and multi-link rear suspension
for enhanced grip and control in harsh conditions.2
Powered by a 2.0L 4-cylinder engine with up to 141
horsepower, Kicks is efficient and ready for adventure.8
With up to four available Drive Modes, you’ll be prepared
to take on the road with confidence.
Snow Mode Facing snow? Kicks’ available Snow Mode
adjusts throttle and gear ratio to help elevate your
traction with peace of mind.1
Sport Mode In Kicks, you can turn up the fun with the push
of a button. Give Sport Mode a try for higher revs and a
tighter feel that can still get you straight to the finish line.
Eco Mode Running low on fuel? Switch it to Eco Mode,
and the engine adjusts acceleration and throttle
response to help stretch the miles.8
Normal Mode Your daily commute is made easier with
Normal Mode. It has the power and agility you need to
easily handle city streets and narrow alleys and brave
even the worst congestion.
